economy.summary: He supported the Keystone Saves Program (H.B. 1263), which would give retirement-savings account access to Pennsylvania workers who lack employer-sponsored plans, saying workers deserve a secure and reliable retirement.
economy.short: Supported Keystone Saves retirement-savings access for workers.

healthcare.summary: He supported H.B. 1123, which requires insurance coverage for colorectal cancer screening beginning at age 45 instead of 50, describing it as a measure aimed at saving lives.
healthcare.short: Supported bill lowering colorectal cancer screening coverage age.

guns.summary: He backed legislation (H.B. 2426, enacted 2024) banning license plate flipping devices, framed as a public-safety and driver-accountability measure rather than a firearms measure, saying it closes loopholes used to evade tolls and payments.
guns.short: Backed ban on license plate flipping devices.

economy.summary: His campaign lists "Affordable Living" as a priority, saying working families and seniors shouldn't be squeezed by rising costs.
economy.short: Lists affordable living; says rising costs squeeze families, seniors.

education.summary: His campaign lists "Strong Public Schools" as a priority, saying schools should be places where students thrive and parents feel respected and heard.
education.short: Lists strong public schools where students thrive as priority.

healthcare.summary: Under a "Support for Seniors & Families" priority, his campaign says everyone deserves a fair shot and access to reliable health care and essential services.
healthcare.short: Says everyone deserves access to reliable health care.

guns.summary: His campaign lists "Safe Neighborhoods" as a priority, saying every family deserves to feel secure on their block and in their home.
guns.short: Lists safe neighborhoods; says families deserve to feel secure.
